rejected.quote: Untreated CNS tumor, epidural tumor or metastasis, or brain metastasis. Patients with any primary CNS malignancy including glioma and current, active, or progressing CNS malignancy, including carcinomatosis meningitis, are excluded. Patients with treated brain metastases are eligible if there is no evidence of progression for at least 4 weeks after CNS-directed treatment
